name: WebGL2 Volume Raycasting
definition: A lightweight web-based volumetric data explorer that renders 3D scalar fields using WebGL2 raymarching in a fragment shader, supporting 8-bit, 16-bit, and float data types, with optional segmentation masks and clipping planes.
summary: WebGL2 Volume Raycasting is a web-based volumetric data explorer that renders 3D scalar fields using WebGL2 raymarching and front-to-back alpha blending, distinguished by its specific handling of integer texture formats and fixed colormaps.
